name: phd-summer-maximum-regular-first
description: Credit-transfer review 2026-10-28 (#28): an early-start summer with 12 credits entered, two over Academic Code §3.8’s ten. The research credits kept the room and the 40000-level course was cut to 1 of 3 (4 of 24), because a course with one cap was always placed before one with two. Regular credit now takes a semester’s room before credit toward the total only: CSE 40113 and CSE 60111 count in full and CSE 98900 counts 4 of its 6 — 6 of 24, the 60 unchanged at 10.

CSE 98900: counts 4 of 6 credits toward the total-credit requirement only; 2 not counted — over the 10-credit summer-session maximum for Summer 2026 (Academic Code §3.8)
